run_test:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Queries a response source in four rounds of 118 attempts, removes letters that appear at least 24 times, and returns a five-character sequence made from the chosen survivors plus the final missing letter." run_test]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> F </REF>: object "Unused parameter retained for the method signature."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: string "The computed five-character string formed by sol + missing[0]."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize sol to an empty string, missing to ['A','B','C','D','E'], and attempt_number to 0. RESULT _state]
            [COMMAND For each i from 1 to 4 inclusive, reset exclude to ['A','B','C','D','E'] and found to {'A':0,'B':0,'C':0,'D':0,'E':0}. RESULT _state]
            [COMMAND For each letter in ['A','B','C','D','E'], if that letter is present in sol, increment found[letter] by 1. RESULT _state]
            [COMMAND For each j from 0 to 117 inclusive, increment attempt_number, call printf(str(5*j+i)), read r = get(), and increment found[r] by 1. RESULT _state]
            [COMMAND For each letter in ['A','B','C','D','E'], if found[letter] >= 24, remove that letter from exclude. RESULT _state]
            [COMMAND If len(exclude) == 1, append exclude[0] to sol and remove exclude[0] from missing; otherwise call printf(str(5 * 118 + i)), read r = get(), remove r from exclude, append exclude[0] to sol, and remove exclude[0] from missing. RESULT _state]
            [COMMAND After all four outer iterations complete, return sol + missing[0]. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
